issues.message: Headline 'BUY ETFs COMMISSION FREE!' is clipped on the right edge — only 'BUY ETFs COMMI' is visible. The remainder of 'COMMISSION FREE!' is cut off by the canvas.
CTA label is truncated to 'START INV' — the full 'START INVESTING' (or equivalent) action verb is cut off by the right edge of the canvas.
CTA pill extends past the right edge of the 300×250 canvas with zero padding; the button shape itself is clipped, not just the label.
Variant replicates the same clipping defects present in the source rather than adapting the layout to fit the 300×250 format. No corrective resizing of headline or CTA has been applied.
Because both headline and CTA are clipped, the visual hierarchy collapses — viewers cannot complete the reading path from value prop to action.
Palette (navy background, yellow headline, white CTA pill, white logo) is consistent with brand. No rogue accents introduced.

notes: Variant is visually identical to the source and inherits its critical clipping defects. Not shippable at 300×250 without re-fitting the headline and CTA inside the canvas with ≥16px padding.
